units.source_text: 薰大将打算叫浮舟迁居到新造的屋子里，又担心外人纷纷宣扬，说“这屋子原来是为小夫人造的！”

en.t: General Kaoru planned to have Ukifune move into the newly built house, but he also worried that outsiders would spread talk everywhere, saying, "This house was originally built for the young lady!"

units.source_text: 因此装饰屏门等事非常秘密。

en.t: For that reason, matters such as decorating the screens and doors were carried out in great secrecy.

units.source_text: 能办此事的人其实甚多，他却派了一个他所亲信的大藏大夫，名叫仲信的，以为此人可靠，吩咐他去装饰房屋。

en.t: There were in fact many people capable of handling the matter, but he sent a trusted official of the Ministry of the Treasury named Nakanobu, thinking him reliable, and ordered him to decorate the rooms.

units.source_text: 这仲信原是大内记道定的岳父，因此辗转传述，事情全都被匂亲王闻知了。

en.t: This Nakanobu happened to be the father-in-law of the Senior Secretary Michisada, and so, through repeated retelling, Prince Niou came to know the whole affair.

units.source_text: 大内记对匂亲王说：“绘屏风的画师，乃从随从人员中选出，都是亲信的家臣。

en.t: The Senior Secretary told Prince Niou, "The painters for the folding screens were chosen from among the attendants, all of them trusted retainers.

units.source_text: 一切设备实在都非常讲究。”

en.t: Every part of the furnishings is truly being prepared with the greatest care."

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻言，越发着急了。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard this, he became more anxious than ever.

units.source_text: 他想起自己有一个乳母，是一个远方国守的妻子，就要随丈夫赴任地去，其任地在下京方面。

en.t: He remembered that one of his nurses was the wife of a provincial governor in a distant region and was about to accompany her husband to his post, which lay in the direction of the lower capital.

units.source_text: 他就嘱托这国守：“有一个极秘密的女子，要暂时隐藏在你家里。”

en.t: He then entrusted the governor with the matter, saying, "There is a woman of the utmost secrecy whom I want you to hide temporarily in your house."

units.source_text: 国守不知道这女子是何等样人，颇感为难。

en.t: The governor did not know what sort of woman she was, and felt quite troubled by the request.

units.source_text: 但因匂亲王郑重其事地托他，不敢不接受，便答道：“遵命。”

en.t: But because Prince Niou asked him so solemnly, he did not dare refuse and answered, "As you command."

units.source_text: 匂亲王安排好了这隐藏所，稍稍放心了。

en.t: After Prince Niou had arranged this hiding place, he felt somewhat relieved.

units.source_text: 国守定于三月底动身赴任地，匂亲王准备就在这天去接浮舟。

en.t: The governor was scheduled to set out for his post at the end of the third month, and Prince Niou planned to fetch Ukifune on that very day.

units.source_text: 派人通知右近：“我已如此布置定当，你们方面务须严守秘密。”

en.t: He sent someone to inform Ukon, "I have arranged things in this way; on your side, you must be absolutely careful to keep the secret."

units.source_text: 但他自己未便亲赴宇治。

en.t: Yet it was not convenient for him to go to Uji in person.

units.source_text: 同时右近也来回信，告诉他那个爱管闲事的乳母在家，叫他不要亲自来接。

en.t: At the same time, Ukon also sent a reply, telling him that the meddlesome nurse was at home and asking him not to come in person to fetch her.
